description: Read a chat's messages, oldest first. Returns the most recent `limit` messages; page back through older ones with starting_after.

chat_id.description: A chat id (aichat_...). A run id works too — it resolves to that run's chat.

ending_before.description: Return the messages older than this id — the first id of the previous page. Paging walks backwards through history, since the default page is the tail.

name: list_messages

outputSchema.description: A page of conversation messages, oldest first.

items.description: One message in a run's conversation.
